 # Remove underscores, dashes, spaces, and special characters except hyphens and commas
 expression = r'[_- ]+|[^a-zA-Z0-9,\s]'
 value = re.sub(expression, '', value)

 # Convert to lowercase and replace hyphen with space
 value = value.lower().replace('-', ' ')

 # Split by space and check if the second word is "voluntary non-profit" or "voluntary non-profit private"
 words = value.split()
 if len(words) >= 2 and (words[1] == 'voluntary' and words[2] == 'non-profit'):
     # If yes, return the hospital type as the third word
     return words[3]
 else:
     # If no, return the original value
     return value
return value
